tutorial.speaker: Shibuya Kanon
tutorial.intro_welcome: Hi! I'm **Shibuya Kanon**. Welcome to the **Love Live! Official Card Game** tutorial!
tutorial.intro_what: This is a **two-player** card game about **school idols**! You'll recruit **Membres** onto your Scène, manage **Énergie**, and perform **Lives** to outshine your opponent.
tutorial.intro_goal: **Win condition:** Réussitefully perform **3 Lives** before your opponent. When your **Live** is a success, that Live moves to the **Réussite Live card storage** — first to three wins the match!
tutorial.intro_decks: This game uses three types of cards. **Membre** cards, **Live** cards and **Énergie** cards. Each player has a **Main Deck** of **60** cards (**48 Membre** cards and **12 Live** cards) and an **Énergie Deck** of **12 Énergie** cards.
tutorial.intro_card_member: **Membre cards** are the idols that will perform on Scène. Pay **Énergie** equal to their cost to play them from your hand. Each Membre has a certain amount of colored **Cœurs** (upright) that are used when performing lives. There are also **Blades** (the round penlight icons) and **Blade hearts** (The sideways hearts), but we'll focus on the upright heart for now. Shiki here has **1 purple heart**.
tutorial.intro_card_live: **Live cards** are the songs you perform. You can play up to 3 at a time. Lives are cleared using the **Membre** cards you've placed on your stage - we'll touch on this more later.
tutorial.intro_card_energy: **Énergie cards** from your **Énergie deck** are placed here. You begin with **3 Énergie** and gain **+1** each turn (until all **12** of your energy is in play). Énergie is spent to place **Membre cards** onto your **stage**.
tutorial.intro_demo: I'll walk you through a demo — **Liella!** vs **μ's** on the playmat. You're at the bottom; your opponent is on top.
tutorial.intro_deck_piles: The top pile is your **Main Deck**, where you draw cards from. Below is the **Énergie deck**.
tutorial.intro_stage: The **Scène** (Left / Centre / Right) is where Membres sit. Their **Cœur** colors and **Blade** values fuel Lives during Performance.
tutorial.intro_live: **Live Storage** holds up to 3 face-down cards during the Phase Live. You'll be able to see your own cards in this web version, but your opponent's cards will be hidden.
tutorial.intro_success: Compléter un **Live** déplace cette carte Live vers la pile **Réussite Storage** ! Gardez une trace de la façon dont vous êtes sur le point de gagner ici !
tutorial.intro_wr: The **Salle d'attente** is the discard pile.
tutorial.intro_hands: Normally your opponent's hand will be hidden, but it's visible for this tutorial. Your hand consists of **Membre** and **Live** cards from your deck.
tutorial.setup_coin: Avant le début du jeu, un **jeton** choisit un gagnant — il **choisit** qui va en premier. Surveillez cela au début de chaque match !
tutorial.setup_coin_p2: Now we can see our **starting hand!**
tutorial.setup_mulligan: You start with **6** cards. If you aren't happy with the cards you pulled, this screen gives you an opportunity to swap out as many cards as you want and draw replacements (We refer to this as a **mulligan**).
tutorial.setup_mull_p1: Game flow: **Phase principale** -> **Phase Live** -> **Performance Phase** -> Repeat.
tutorial.setup_mull_p2: **Phase principale!**. A new card was drawn from your deck.
tutorial.t1_structure: Each **Phase principale**, the first player acts, then the second — that's where you play Membres... and use skills. You'll press **End Phase principale** here when you're done performing actions.
tutorial.t1_energy_refresh: Au début d'un nouveau tour, vous gagnerez **+1 énergie**. Vous continuerez à gagner * * 1 * * d'énergie à chaque nouveau tour jusqu'à ce que toutes les **12** cartes d'énergie soient en jeu.
tutorial.t1_main_p1: Liella's **Phase principale** — let's play a Membre card first!
tutorial.t1_play_shiki_plain: We spend **2 Énergie** to play this card and send it to a free spot on our Scène! (Spent Énergie is flipped sideways)
tutorial.t1_no_skill: We now have a single member in the center of our stage. If you don't have the required energy to place more cards, you can end your main phase.
tutorial.t1_end_main_p1: Liella ends their Phase principale — it's now the opponent's turn to set their cards!
tutorial.t1_main_p2: μ's plays **Rin Hoshizora** to their Scène - with **1 pink heart**.
tutorial.t1_hearts: You can see the total amount of **Cœurs** and **Blades** for the cards active on your and your opponent's **Scène** up here!
tutorial.t1_end_main_p2: After both players complete their Phase principale, it's time for the **Phase Live**!
tutorial.t1_live_intro: Place 0–3 cards (Live or Membre) in **Live card storage**. Draw 1 new card from your deck for each card you placed. Membre cards placed in Live storage will be discarded in the next phase — you can replace unwanted cards this way!
tutorial.t1_live_p1: When you set a **Live** card in the Live phase, it must be attempted later in the same turn, so choose wisely! Liella sets **WE WILL!!** — it needs 1 **red** heart, 1 **purple** heart, and 1 additional heart of **any color** (indicated by a grey heart) to be cleared successfully.
tutorial.t1_live_p1_lock: Liella Ends their **Phase Live**, locking in their selection. Unlike the Phase principale, you and your opponent's Phase Live occurs at the same time. If your opponent's Phase Live is not over yet, you'll wait for them to finish before moving on.
tutorial.t1_live_p2: μ's sets a **Live** face-down in storage - You'll see what it is in the **Performance Phase**.
tutorial.t1_end: Turn 1 done — you played a Membre, set a Live, and learned **Cœur matching** during Performance.
tutorial.t2_start: **Turn 2** — Une carte est tirée sur votre main et vous gagnez +1 d'énergie.
tutorial.t2_skill_intro: The cards we've played so far only give **hearts** and **blades**, but some cards also have **skills** that affect the game in various ways. Take a look at this card, it features skill text.
tutorial.t2_skill_preview: This is an **[À l'entrée]** skill, meaning when this card enters the stage from your hand, something happens.
tutorial.t2_play_shiki_skill: Liella plays Shiki to the right slot. Watch — the game will ask if you want her **À l'entrée** effect.
tutorial.t2_on_enter_offer: If a skill says "you may" that means activating it is optional, and you can choose to skip the effect. Liella agrees to **activate** the skill. After paying **1 Énergie**, Liella can choose a new card from the top of their deck to add to their hand!
tutorial.t2_on_enter_confirm: Now they pick which card to keep. Liella will choose **1 card** to keep, and send the others back to the **Salle d'attente**.
tutorial.t2_on_enter_result: Shiki's skill resolves — one card joins Liella's hand, two go to the **Salle d'attente**. That's an **[À l'entrée]** skill in action.
tutorial.t2_main_p2: μ's plays an affordable Membre to add Cœurs.
tutorial.t2_live_skill_intro: Live cards can have skills too! Some have **[Début de Live]** — that triggers when that Live's performance begins.
tutorial.t3_start: **Turn 3** — μ's goes first this turn because they cleared the only Réussite Live last Performance.
tutorial.t3_main_p2: μ's plays an affordable Membre to add Cœurs.
tutorial.t3_turn: **Turn 3** — your Phase principale. You drew a card and gained **+1 Énergie** (**6** in storage).
tutorial.t3_baton_intro: I'll now explain another mechanic called **Baton Pass**. By playing a card over another card already on your Scène, you can **swap** the old card with the new one. When Baton Passing, you're treated as having paid the replaced Membre's cost by moving them to the **Salle d'attente** — you'll only pay the **difference** in Énergie.
tutorial.t3_baton_example: **Mei Yoneme** costs **7** — normally **7 Énergie** from hand, but Baton Pass over **Shiki** (cost **4**) on **Right** costs only **3** (7−4). **Shiki** stays on **Centre** (**2 Blade**), **Mei** on **Right** adds **1 red** and **2 purple** — you'll set **Mirai wa Kaze no You ni** from **hand** in the **Phase Live**, and Scène is one Cœur short of clearing it until **Yell**.
tutorial.skill_glossary_intro: You've now seen several skill timings live. Here are common **keywords** you'll see on cards:
tutorial.skill_on_enter: **[À l'entrée]** — fires once when the Membre is played from hand onto your Scène (like Shiki just did). Many say *you may* — they're optional.
tutorial.skill_live_start: **[Début de Live]** — fires when a Live performance with that card begins (like START:DASH). Also often optional.
tutorial.skill_activated: **[Activé]** — during your Phase principale, use the buttons under **Activatable skills**. Some Membres like **Kinako** can leave Scène to add a **Live** from your **Salle d'attente** to your hand.
tutorial.skill_wr_note: Some **[Activé]** skills only work while the Membre is **in the Salle d'attente** — the list shows **WR ·** before their name. Scène skills show the slot instead.
tutorial.skill_always: **[Permanent]** / **[Automatique]** — stays active while conditions are met; no button to press. **Automatique** triggers by itself when something happens.
tutorial.skill_once: **[Une fois par tour]** — even if you could pay the cost again, you only get one use each turn.
tutorial.skill_center: **[Centre]** — only works if that Membre is in the **center** Scène slot.
tutorial.skill_on_leave: **[À la sortie]** — fires when the Membre leaves Scène (Baton Pass, removal effects, etc.).
tutorial.t3_stage_hearts: With **Left** open, set **Mirai wa Kaze no You ni** from **hand** in the **Phase Live**. **Shiki** on **Centre** and **Mei** on **Right** supply some Cœurs — **Mirai wa Kaze no You ni** still needs some more Cœurs, which will hopefully be provided by **Yell**. **Mirai wa Kaze no You ni**'s skill allows **Yell** hearts to count as **any** color, so that improves our chances.
tutorial.t3_live1: Liella sets **Mirai wa Kaze no You ni** from **hand**.
tutorial.outro: Boucle principale : **Main → Live Set → Performance → Judge**. Les compétences ajoutent du piquant par-dessus. Essayez ensuite **Pratique vs CPU** !
